capture_method: Actual Cua browser-tab screenshots sampled approximately every 500 ms within capture blocks; silent. No UI reconstruction or synthetic app frames. H.264 repeats held frames at 10 fps; original motion sampling is ~2 fps.
editing: Outside the uninterrupted exercise, gaps over 3 seconds are shortened to 3 seconds. Within the exercise all timestamp gaps are retained, holding the last captured frame. Last frame held 2.5 seconds. Enable English subtitles; full transcript accompanies video.

chapters.text: Final Assignment 3.3 demonstration: current coastal mello interface, running Vue/FastAPI/SQLite on localhost with fictional inputs. Three approved skills; assistant only in the lower-right popup.
Explicit fictional profile: remembered Text only, Brief reminders, and opted-in factual practice context. Save confirms the database write; no mood, diagnosis or distress is inferred.
Reload restores the saved profile and Text only cue. Override with Animated circle for this visit; the remembered choice stays Text only. The user can correct or reset these explicit choices.

Guided skill: four one-second counts in, six out, six cycles. No typing, model call or save response is required during pacing. Pause, End and independent Crisis support remain available. Breathing has no app audio.

Completed: the full six-cycle sequence finished on the current interface. Measured exercise, entry/setup, excluded pause and confirmed save status are shown separately; completion is not a clinical outcome.
History shows the actual skill, status, dates, initial/final cue and measured timing. This record persisted in SQLite; Completed, Stopped, Interrupted and Not started remain distinct.

Personalization example: the saved brief-reply profile and opted-in factual breathing history tailor reviewed text. It distinguishes current Animated circle, remembered Text only and latest completed practice. No emotional state or improvement is inferred.

Optional live model: current question plus approved app facts go to local Ollama. It selects a catalog topic; reviewed copy is displayed. Profile/history tailoring stays in local rules, outside the model.
Actual request failure: the isolated API was stopped. This question is not confirmed saved, and Retry is offered. Existing saved records are not proof that this new turn was persisted.
Independent support opens while the API is physically offline, without a classifier or model decision. Nobody monitors this prototype. No external call, text or service chat is initiated.
Recovery: the same isolated database/host run was restarted without a new model call or preload. Explicit Retry confirms this turn. The host ledger remains 11 of 50; mock replies stay the default.
